in_hebrew.name: Autum
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Autum הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English āt geweorc or ēoten geweorc, meaning ‘autumnal work’ or ‘harvest work’. Autumn is the season of abundance and change, symbolizing the cycle of life, growth, and renewal in nature.

in_greek.name: Autum
in_greek.long_meaning: Autum είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English āt geweorc or ēoten geweorc, meaning ‘autumnal work’ or ‘harvest work’. Autumn is the season of abundance and change, symbolizing the cycle of life, growth, and renewal in nature.

in_latin.name: Autum
in_latin.long_meaning: Autum est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English āt geweorc or ēoten geweorc, meaning ‘autumnal work’ or ‘harvest work’. Autumn is the season of abundance and change, symbolizing the cycle of life, growth, and renewal in nature.
